audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page tracked a fabricated ability called "Subject: Fear (CC Paints)". Hwei's E is Subject: Torment. The fake name appeared in focus.text, winCon, enemyWin, loading, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[2].d, report[3].t, report[5].t and report[9].t. The spikes also mis-slotted the sub-abilities: they called Grim Visage "EE" and invented a "WW dash-hop" and an "EW fear".
audit.why: Riot's own text lists the E palette in order as Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, Crushing Maw (EQ/EW/EE) and the W palette as Fleeting Current, Pool of Reflection, Stirring Lights. The page's slot letters contradict that ordering, and which sub-spell is the fear versus the root is not in Riot's text at all, so I rewrote around the palette name rather than re-asserting a slot.
audit.corrected: Every reference now reads Subject: Torment (E), with its real cooldown (12s at rank 1, 10s at rank 5). Subject: Serenity (W) 18s and Spiraling Despair 120s at rank 1 added.
sources: brief.enemyKit Q/W/E/R names, text and cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[6].side read "Skill" while content win[6] read "Hwei" — the page answered "who wins at 2+ items" two different ways. The full-layer why under it also described Lux winning that stage.
audit.why: Content and the packet levelChart agree on Hwei at 2+ items, and it is grounded: three palettes plus Spiraling Despair give him more answers than Lux's single root.
audit.corrected: phases[6].side moved to Hwei and phases[6].why rewritten in the same proposal to match. win[6] already read Hwei, so no content edit was written (a no-op would be rejected and would take the chart group down).

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike list described Hwei's late lead but never named the ranges that create it, and the level-6 comparison did not state that Lux's R reaches 3340 against Spiraling Despair's 1300.
audit.why: That range gap is the concrete reason Lux keeps a snipe threat into a losing scaling matchup.
audit.corrected: Range numbers folded into spikes[3].text and breakdown.carry.

audit.whatIsWrong: Subject: Serenity (W) shields, and it absorbs the burst window Lux is committing into — the page never said so.
audit.why: Flagged in missingInteractions (shield-absorbs-burst) and confirmed by the shield flag on Hwei's W. It is on 18s at rank 1, the longest of his basic palettes.
audit.corrected: Written into dosFull[2].d and report[9].t: force the shield out before you commit.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim under "Weave the passive auto after each spell"; dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string verbatim under "Burn R on waves while fights spawn"; breakdown.cooldowns held no digit (all three lint findings).

edits.after: Win the margins with passive autos, then convert one root per cycle into laser math. Track Subject: Torment (E), 12s at rank 1, before every commit and hold the wave where your pattern works.

edits.before: Both of you are immobile long-range casters, so the lane is a poke duel decided by who lands their skillshot first. Your Q (Light Binding) is a hard root that sets up your full E-Q-R combo, but Hwei's EE (Grim Visage) roots too and his QQ (Devastating Fire) out-pokes you if you stand still. Weave your E (Lucent Singularity) at max range, detonate on contact, and only commit Q when he wastes his WW dash-hop or EE.
edits.after: Both of you are immobile long-range casters, so the lane is a poke duel decided by who lands their skillshot first. Your Q (Light Binding) is a hard root that sets up your full E-Q-R combo, but his Subject: Torment (E) palette answers with its own lockdown and Devastating Fire out-pokes you if you stand still. Weave your E (Lucent Singularity) at max range, detonate on contact, and commit Q only once his Torment palette is spent.

edits.before: Hwei edges you into 2+ items: his combos delete you if a single root or fear lands, and his ult controls the fight from range you cannot match. Play flank angles, save Q as a peel root, and fire R only after his EE and W dash are on cooldown.
edits.after: Hwei edges you into 2+ items: his combos delete you if a single Torment lockdown lands, and Spiraling Despair controls the fight at 1300 range. Play flank angles, save Q as a peel root, and fire R only after his E palette is on cooldown.
